question.text: After immediately uploading KYC information to the KRA system, within how many working days from execution of documents by the client must the intermediary send the KYC documents to the KRA?

explanation.text: The Logic: The intermediary shall immediately upload KYC information on the KRA system and send the KYC documents to the KRA within 10 working days from the date of execution of documents by the client. The Trap: Candidates may guess shorter timelines like 5 or 7 days. The upload itself must be immediate; the 10-working-day window is specifically prescribed for dispatching the KYC documents. Note: The upload-immediately requirement and the 10-working-day document-dispatch requirement are two distinct obligations under the KRA framework.
